description: Use the order_capability saved at order creation to read paid order status and obtain or renew a delivery token. It works with a new valid session if the original session expired; a current session is required. No email recovery; keep this credential private until file retention ends. After an original full refund, top-level add_on describes any separate purchase. If add_on.delivery_available is true, next_action is fetch_delivery and the renewed token can list/download only extra.* files; delivery.rows_url is null. The original refund status and original-file 410 remain unchanged.

order_id.description: Order number, e.g. GMD7K3P9Q. Lowercase or hyphenated input (gmd-7k3p9q) is accepted.
